folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: full incumbent map and actual finite joins, 2026-11-04 (B371)
folds.body:
The complete machine map was reviewed, not inferred from its title or summary. It contains35MF families, tenMF gaps, fiveINC packets, twentyRB findings, thirteen incumbent paths, fiveWCqueue entries, sixoptional-depth descriptions,94input fingerprints and sevenlater acceptance groups. Each MF family explicitly sets behaviorVerifiedByThisReview:false. “Delivered,” an empty requiredRemaining list, a source symbol or a matching old hash cannot establish full subsystem depth or current native behavior. The read-only950-command registry snapshot and the943-command historical build remain different inputs. No underlying file, source trace or fingerprint was checked by proxy.

Preserve the narrow mechanisms that make these joins useful: completion consumes the actual popped job’s frozen participants/cost/effect/revision/cause; stale current options do not rewrite an accepted job. Borrowed held use needs exact same-loan owner/holder/key/count/reference, cannot authorize destructive spending or concurrent return and must restore only the recorded means. A deposit refund returns held funds rather than minting a reward. Teacher-held knowledge, learner-owned procedure, measured strip, actual opted-in drain, plot/harvest claim and real native material/cooking consumer are distinct. Alternate cover/report routes must not duplicate one plot’s harvest, reveal private truth or erase prior frozen branches.

Mature survey effort saving, a knowledge receipt, a usable material output and a funded recipient are different benefits. A concrete payoff can coexist with ordinary/fine alternatives and existing seven cumulative endings; a public chapter account does not accept new duties, infer private motives, fabricate rescue or force a final selector. Known People needs received introductions and actual reports rather than registry access. Native river swimming and the distant earned river route retain their own actual access/cost, so a nearby new interaction does not become a teleport or duplicate yield.

The MF/INC/RB crosswalk distinguishes selected fixed functions, missing local joins and optional universal systems. Bodies, population economies, generic attacks, all-world adaptation, offline/reset frameworks, ECS/renderers, broader sources and parked packets remain useful possibilities rather than mandatory finish requirements. The old one-realm/one-prestige milestone and historical care/assay reservations do not determine current priorities or ownership. Current LOTM/Harry direction, AD51 and actual present source/adoption evidence govern separately selected work. This batch does not settle the historical root queue anew or certify that any old missing consumer is still missing.

Keep actual native schema admission, absence defaults, frozen-job meaning, one durable publication and matched final bundle as separate checks. Source connections are not generated save/reload/import/failed-write or keyboard/browser proof, and a finished source-review leaf is not completed gameplay under AD43. AD42 makes human review optional while preserving actual technical gaps. No runtime, source library, private save, worker/process, build, registry import, gameplay or source-body verification was run by this reconciliation.
